title: khaaliNames
tagline: Comprehensive smart contract suite for onchain user management
description:
khalliNames is a complete smart contract suite for user management, powered by ENSv2.

Features ::
- Generate unique names as identifiers
- Milestones to track user growth
- Onchain AppStore enablement
- Monetising vanity aliasing
- Emancipation without data being held hostage (ie, true user owned data)
how_its_made:
The project is extremely modular, where every piece is swappable. At the foundational layer is an onchain name generation utility and ENSv2's PermissionedRegistry and PermissionedResolver contracts. The name generation utility feeds the registry to enable unique usernames. ENSv2's Enhanced Access Control allows for nuanced permission scoping across the entire tree. 

The final result is an onchain app store where users are part of the same universe while also truly controlling their own data!
